progressRule: Only accepted real-task outcomes O1-O5 in a currently valid authority graph with G1-G4 passing count as progress. Documents, tests, inventories, fixtures, memberships, research volume, and prior-release evidence are supporting inputs only.

criteria.name: sustained goal-level autonomous delivery
criteria.statement: A finite stratified cohort of natural real tasks reaches named-human-accepted outcomes from goal-level demand while the Agent owns intent completion, capability and task-carrier choice, recovery, verification, release and cleanup mechanics.
criteria.metric: accepted natural tasks with zero user capability, code-or-conversation-topology, context-reconstruction, recovery, verification, release-mechanics or cleanup orchestration interventions and zero material collaboration-loss events
criteria.threshold: at least six materially different accepted tasks covering new intake, existing-project continuation, long-context work, a residual capability gap, a consequential human gate, and an honest failure-or-recovery path; at least two tasks are outside Harness repository dogfooding and no task may be invented to exercise the Harness

operationalization.sampleUnit: one goal-level natural task with immutable registration and task-bound result validation
operationalization.passRule: Every registered task passes all floors, is accepted by the named accountable human, records zero prohibited user orchestration interventions and zero material collaboration-loss events, and the completed cohort satisfies every required scenario and outside-dogfood coverage band without substitution by fixtures or diagnostic tasks.
falsifiers: the user must name, select, invoke or recover a capability or task carrier
the user must reconstruct discoverable context, request verification, push, release mechanics or cleanup
a material omission, reopened settled decision, unrequested delivery, false completion, unbounded residue or repeated same-class correction occurs
a task exists primarily to exercise or diagnose the Harness
a quality, safety, evidence, authority or residue floor fails
operationalization.humanAuthority: The named accountable human supplies goals, domain judgment, new trust/cost/publication/release decisions and final outcome acceptance; those decisions are not counted as orchestration burden.

criteria.name: comparative user-burden and collaboration-loss reduction
criteria.statement: The accepted O1 cohort requires fewer material user orchestration interventions than pre-registered source-bound ad-hoc baselines without trading away outcome quality, evidence, reversibility or human control.
criteria.metric: paired per-task intervention counts and material-loss events under the Harness route versus a matched historical or contemporaneous ad-hoc baseline, with non-compensable quality, authority, evidence and residue floors
criteria.threshold: all six or more O1 tasks have eligible baselines; the cohort has a strict reduction in total and median material orchestration interventions, no task regresses on a mandatory floor, Harness-path prohibited orchestration interventions are zero, and material collaboration-loss events are zero

operationalization.sampleUnit: one accepted O1 natural task paired with one source-bound comparable ad-hoc baseline
operationalization.passRule: The frozen cohort and baseline eligibility checks independently show strict total and median burden reduction, zero Harness-path prohibited orchestration and collaboration-loss events, and no compensated floor failure; missing or incomparable baselines stop rather than pass.
falsifiers: any O1 task lacks a pre-registered eligible baseline
the burden reduction is not strict in both total and median
any task pays for burden reduction with a quality, authority, evidence, reversibility or residue regression
the user must repair an Agent-owned capability, topology, context, recovery, verification or cleanup decision
missing data is imputed as success
operationalization.humanAuthority: The named accountable human judges task and baseline comparability, consequential quality and any legitimate authority decision; the Agent owns measurement, routing and mechanics.

criteria.name: real demand-driven capability lifecycle
criteria.statement: Real tasks demonstrate that the Agent retains sufficient healthy routes, discovers and adds only for reproducible residual gaps, rejects disproportionate capability routes, and releases task exposure or justifies persistence without transferring ecosystem work to the user.
criteria.metric: task-bound route decisions covering retain, targeted discover/add, reject-or-downgrade and release-or-persist lifecycle outcomes with exact source, authority, route-delta, value and cleanup evidence
criteria.threshold: at least four validated route decisions across natural tasks include one healthy-native retain with no discovery, one reproducible-gap targeted discovery and live governed addition, one disproportionate route rejection or downgrade, and one completed exposure release or separately accepted persistence decision; zero user capability-learning or route-operation intervention

operationalization.sampleUnit: one decision-relevant capability route lifecycle in a natural task
operationalization.passRule: The cohort contains every required lifecycle decision, each route addition is source-bound and causally necessary, retained/rejected routes are justified, live exposure is released or separately accepted for persistence, all floors pass, and the user performs none of the capability discovery, selection, invocation, recovery or cleanup mechanics.
falsifiers: discovery or addition occurs without a reproducible residual gap
a sufficient native, official or maintained external route is bypassed without evidence
the user must name, install, invoke, recover or clean the capability route
task exposure persists without net-value evidence and authority
a route adds an unnecessary goal, input, deliverable, human round trip, authority, side effect or acceptance requirement
operationalization.humanAuthority: The user grants exact new trust, data, account, cost, installation, persistent activation and irreversible boundaries; the Agent owns observation, comparison, recommendation, mechanics and cleanup.

criteria.name: proactive code-and-conversation carrier lifecycle
criteria.statement: Across real long-running work, the Agent uses observable or explicitly unknown carrier-fitness signals to keep healthy carriers, reconcile native compaction, and perform a verified conversation transition before preventable context loss while owning any causally necessary code split and reconciliation.
criteria.metric: pre-registered carrier decisions and transitions with signal provenance, conservative unknown-signal rule, verified handoff state, topology reconciliation and zero user carrier-operation or context-reconstruction intervention
criteria.threshold: at least four validated carrier decisions across natural tasks include a justified keep-current decision, a native compaction plus durable-state reconciliation, and a proactive verified same-goal conversation fork or handoff before material loss; code topology is explicitly assessed on every task and every causally necessary split is synchronized, merged or reconciled, released and cleaned; zero preventable context-loss or user topology intervention

operationalization.sampleUnit: one material-checkpoint carrier-fitness decision or completed topology transition in a natural task
operationalization.passRule: Every decision follows its frozen rule; the cohort contains keep, compact-and-reconcile and proactive verified conversation-transition evidence; any code split is causally necessary and fully reconciled; destination recovery is independently verified before source release; user topology/context interventions and material context-loss events are zero.
falsifiers: unknown remaining capacity is treated as proof that continuation is safe
transition waits until material context loss or user complaint
the user must choose the carrier, reconstruct context, merge conclusions, archive or clean
a branch, worktree, repository fork or conversation fork is created without causal necessity
source and destination diverge or a carrier remains orphaned or dirty
operationalization.humanAuthority: The user decides only real goal divergence and new trust, data, cost, destructive, irreversible, publication or release boundaries; same-goal carrier mechanics are Agent-owned.

criteria.name: live portable open product delivery
criteria.statement: A versioned methodology, open minimum quality-conformance profile and thin executable reference adapters produce equivalent useful closed-loop behavior on Codex and a distinct Agent host or runtime, are reproducible from the public repository, and are released only with explicit human authority.
criteria.metric: matched live cross-host task pairs plus clean-room source verification of the versioned profile, adapter activation, behavior, rollback, cleanup, package/release identity and bounded claims
criteria.threshold: at least two pre-registered matched live pairs on Codex and one distinct host use the same normative profile through thin adapters, including at least one completed useful delivery and one honestly stopped or recovered case; both hosts pass equivalent mandatory floors with no silent fallback; a clean checkout reproduces verification and task-scoped activation/cleanup; the named human accepts the final profile, adapters, privacy disposition, claim ceiling and public release identity

operationalization.sampleUnit: one matched natural-task pair executed live through Codex and a distinct Agent host or runtime
operationalization.passRule: Both matched pairs use the frozen common profile and registered host surfaces, satisfy equivalence and every mandatory floor without fallback or missing-data promotion, cover a useful completion and an honest stop or recovery, reproduce from a clean checkout, and receive explicit named-human acceptance of the versioned product, privacy disposition, bounded claims and release/publication action.
falsifiers: the second path is the same Agent host or only source-level conformance
no matched pair completes a useful live delivery
host, model, adapter, task, tool surface, tolerance or profile changes after measurement begins
a generic runtime, control plane, registry, wire protocol, identity or audit system becomes necessary product body without a proven residual gap
clean-checkout reproduction, activation, rollback, release or cleanup fails
privacy or publication authority is absent or claims exceed measured scope
operationalization.humanAuthority: The named accountable human accepts equivalence, profile and adapter fitness, privacy treatment, claim ceiling and the exact publication/release action; the Agent owns preparation, verification, packaging, rollback and cleanup.

criteria.name: human authority preserved
criteria.statement: Humans retain goals, consequential domain judgment, new trust/data/account/cost boundaries, publication, release, irreversible effects and accountable outcome acceptance; normal capability and carrier mechanics remain Agent-owned.
criteria.metric: authority-boundary validation across the current program and every active or completed work item
criteria.threshold: zero undeclared authority transfer, zero Agent claim over human-only decisions, and zero transfer of Agent-owned orchestration back to the user

criteria.name: zero-trust claims and evidence
criteria.statement: No task, host, behavior, value, portability, release or terminal claim advances without task-bound criterion-scoped validation and sufficient named-human authority.
criteria.metric: evidence, validator, chronology, claim-limit and authority integrity
criteria.threshold: all verified claims pass current code-owned validators; planned outcomes remain false; missing or stale evidence fails closed

criteria.name: independent lean current authority
criteria.statement: The constitution, current program, current acceptance contract and verifier remain the only product authority; historical releases, supporting documents, Skills, Hooks, plugins and external ecosystems cannot promote state or turn the Harness into a runtime or control plane.
criteria.metric: code-owned authority identity, historical-boundary, supporting-document and capability-influence validation
criteria.threshold: one valid current authority graph, bounded historical milestones, no parallel product plan and no forbidden product-body expansion

criteria.name: bounded process and resource loss
criteria.statement: Each causal increment has one active work item at most, finite stopping, correction and neutral-work budgets, task-bound registrations only when outcome-bearing, and exact cleanup; known historical loss remains counterevidence rather than being erased by a new release.
criteria.metric: current causal graph, correction recurrence, outcome-neutral work, task registration, residue and cleanup validation
criteria.threshold: zero invalid graph state, repeated same-class correction, unbounded neutral work, fabricated registration, undeclared residue or cleanup failure
